description: Print Yarbrain lesson counts at session start, and let only the Yarbrain gate agent judge lessons in Claude Code.

hooks.command: command -v yarbrain >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; yarbrain hook session-start --contract 1
command -v yarbrain >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; yarbrain hook pre-tool-use --contract 1
